prompts.digital-twin:
Create a 16:9 industrial voxel concept illustration on a near-black background, viewed from an oblique overhead angle. A miniature voxel city diorama rests on a dark graphite plane like an architectural model. High above it, far from any rooftop, a tiny voxel aircraft glides across the open sky, small in the frame. The diorama is drawn at two levels of detail: the part nearest the viewer resolves into fine, discrete point-like voxels, while the far part stays as coarse cubic masses, like a level-of-detail octree refining. A few white structural hairlines frame the diorama; one restrained #e0322d accent line marks the region being refined. Hard edges, soft light from one direction, generous negative space. A schematic model, not a product screenshot. No text, numbers, or logos.

Shared style: 所有新插画共享同一工业级体素语言：近黑背景、石墨灰几何、白色结构线与克制的 #e0322d 系红色重点；硬边、离散采样、发丝线标注区域与充足留白。采用一致的斜俯视透视和单一方向的柔和照明，不使用幻灯片式渐变、玻璃拟态、霓虹光晕、文字、数字或标志。插画仅解释概念，不冒充实际产品截图或研发成果。

No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Wide composition with generous dark negative space on the left third for overlaid copy.

prompts.fleet-control:
Create a 16:9 industrial voxel concept illustration on a near-black background, viewed from an oblique overhead angle. A small light-graphite voxel airplane with a white canopy and red wingtips leads a loose formation of eight tiny voxel quadcopter drones (four rotors each, compact square bodies), evenly spaced in a V and a line, flying over a dark hairline ground grid. Below them, two parallel lawnmower coverage lanes are drawn as dotted white hairlines, and one thin #e0322d line links the drones to a shared clock marker. Civil research aesthetic only: no military aircraft, no jets, no weapons. Hard edges, soft light from one direction, generous negative space on the left. Concept illustration, not a product screenshot. No text, numbers, or logos.

prompts.relay-agents:
Create a 16:9 industrial voxel concept illustration in the same oblique overhead view. Set a few low graphite-gray nest structures on a near-black ground plane, with sparse white hairlines tracing a route between them. At one handoff point, a recognizable voxel airplane continues forward as a smaller, simplified wingmate takes up the next route segment. Use broken lines and one restrained #e0322d voxel accent to distinguish the transfer; keep the routes visibly schematic rather than depicting a live network. Hard edges, discrete sampling, single-direction soft light, and generous negative space. No buttons, interface panels, text, numbers, logos, or claim of a public feature.

prompts.roadmap:
Create a 16:9 industrial voxel concept illustration from the established oblique overhead perspective. A recognizable graphite-gray voxel airplane rises from a compact, solid sandbox platform into open near-black space. Ahead, place two separate, unconnected skeletal voxel frames: the nearer frame has a few partially assembled structural elements, while the farther frame is sparser and less resolved. Separate all three stages with clear gaps; use thin white hairlines and a single restrained #e0322d accent near the departing aircraft. Maintain hard edges, soft light from one direction, and ample negative space. Depict prospective fidelity tiers only, not working interfaces, reconstruction results, or photorealistic imagery. No text, numbers, or logos.
